senses.gloss:
उग्र उग्र, probably वज् + र,
 I. adj. f. रा,
 1. Very strong (ved.).
 2. Terrible, Rām. 4, 22, 35; Bhag. 11, 31.
 3. Cruel, Man. 4, 212.
 4. Rigorous, Man. 6, 75.
 --Compar. उग्रतर, as rigorous as possible, Man. 6, 24.
 II. m. and f. रा, The offspring of a Kṣatriya father and a Śūdrā mother, Man. 10, 9; 19.
 III. m. A proper name, MBh. 1, 2738.
 --Comp.
अनन्त-, अमर-, उग्र-, देव- + शक्ति अनन्त-, अमर-, उग्र-, देव- + शक्ति, बहु-, m. proper names, Pañc. 3, 11. 12; 183, 20.
उग्र- + श्रवण उग्र- + श्रवण, adj. dreadful to hear, Johns. Sel. 96, 79.
